title: Every signal at its worst: Tor, burst velocity, spoofed shared device, $3,500 in gift cards
narrative: A $3,500 gift-card purchase, the seventh or eighth transaction on the card in an hour, from a Tor exit node behind a VPN in a different country from the billing address, on an unrecognized device that is shared across accounts and whose OS fingerprint has changed.
rationale: All three independent dimensions are at their worst, on the merchant category most used to cash out stolen cards. Decline. Critical is the natural severity; high is accepted because no analyst would act differently.
